features.quote: Loop ends when:** model calls `finish`, OR max turns reached, OR a hard error budget is hit
Cap nudges at 3, then treat as termination-by-abandonment (a measurable outcome — log it)
`finish(summary)` — terminal action; model uses this to end the loop.
Error message should be neutral and informative
Refusal/safety divergence.** Some models may refuse, ask clarifying questions, or moralize. Log and treat as a distinct outcome, not as instability.
features.justification_quote: Log and treat as a distinct outcome, not as instability
